title: Use a bounded past weight on one Itô cell
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Use a bounded past weight on one Itô cell. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Multiply the input on one Itô cell by a bounded real random variable known at the left endpoint. The literal weighted input is progressive and square integrable. Its terminal integral agrees almost surely with the weight times the original completed increment.
